purpose: Independent semantic trials for Acceptance 1, 2 and 5. These are inputs and judgment criteria, not executable semantic tests or installed-host evidence.
execution: Use an isolated temporary project per case. Materialize files verbatim; an unreadable fixture is permission-denied, not absent. Give the executor only id, files, context, request and current_date, withholding checks. Capture actual tool calls, output, final file bytes and diff. Baseline receives no roadmap skill; skill arm receives SKILL.md. Launch baseline before or with skill arm, with identical host/model/effort/tools and inputs. Grade both using checks and preserve failures. Do not run external models without consent.
